ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, what does the spotted owl consume directly?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. The owl labeled "Spotted owl" is located in the upper part of the image, slightly right of center; the red tree vole labeled "Red tree vole" is located to its right. There is an arrow in the diagram pointing from the direction of "Red tree vole" to "Spotted owl". Reasoning: In a food web, arrows point to the consumer, indicating that the organism being pointed to directly eats the organism from which the arrow comes. Therefore, the spotted owl directly preys on the red tree vole.
